_comment: Item definitions. category: material | lootbox | placeable | source | structure. Everything lives in the pocket universe: materials are matter in grid cells, and the rest are built in cells. Materials follow the cosmology: hydrogen and helium are primordial, while carbon and iron only come out of collapsing caches for now. Items with a lootTable are caches: they sit in a cell (or an enclosure's chamber) until opened. Enclosures (placeable with maxExposureStacks > 0) hold one cache and one radiation source, both built into them; sources name a radiation id from radiation.json. Structures are part of the pocket universe: actions create them and they can't be dismantled. An overdensity (structure with maxAmplitude > 0) yields the current epoch's yieldTable into its own cell every yieldSeconds, one roll per amplitude. stackSize only matters for uniqueness (1). The loot_box item is shown to players as the Quantum Cache (ids keep the old name).

items.tooltip: Primordial hydrogen: a lone proton, and three quarters of all the matter there will ever be.
Primordial helium, fused in the first few minutes. A quarter of all the matter there will ever be.
Forged when three helium nuclei fuse. No star has shone yet, so only the crush inside a collapsing cache is enough to make it.
The end of the fusion road: fusing iron costs energy instead of releasing it. Only the most compressed caches collapse this far.

Primordial gas crushed into a sealed cache in superposition: what's inside isn't decided until it's observed. Open it to collapse it, and its contents land in its cell. The crush fuses some of the gas into carbon and, rarely, iron.
A quantum ripple stretched to cosmic size. It's a little denser than its surroundings, so it gathers whatever matter the epoch has to offer into its cell. Each amplitude adds a roll to its yield.
A light, graphite-lined radiation chamber. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.
A heavy steel-plated radiation chamber. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.
A broad-spectrum lamp. Visible light drives photosynthesis: caches yield more carbon. Built into an irradiation enclosure.
Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls. Built into an irradiation enclosure.
Ore extraction: caches yield more iron. Built into an irradiation enclosure.
Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that. Built into an irradiation enclosure.
Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Built into an iron enclosure.
